_about: The tales the promo media show. Each is made through the app's own API (npm run promo:content), then read along `path`: the index of the choice taken on each page. `narrate` lists how many pages along the path are recorded, so the videos never wait on the narrator. Heroes are a role and a trait, settings a place, tones the app's own moods (src/lib/themes.ts).

tales.hero: a lamplighter who is afraid of the dark
tales.setting: a walled city on the longest night of winter

tales.hero: the only engineer awake on a sleeper ship, who talks to the plants
a night-shift pharmacist who notices everything and says nothing
tales.setting: an all-night drugstore on Sunset Boulevard

tales.hero: a seasick mapmaker pressed into a pirate crew
tales.setting: a reef that is on no chart

tales.hero: a child who can step into paintings
a shepherd an oracle named a hero by mistake
